name: smwpatches-wall-springboard-interaction-wraparound-fix
title: Wall Springboard Interaction Wraparound Fix
description:
Fixes a bug in SMW that wall springboard interactions would wrap around the screen in both the X and Y axis when being on the edge of the screen.

This is because the interactions only account for the XY low byte positions. This patch adds a check if the player is 128 or more pixels away from the "origin" of the sprite along the X or Y axis, would ignore interaction.
